title: Belligerent Pregnant Woman Denounces 'Fake Cops' and Resists Arrest!
description:
On August 19th, 2023, officers in Ohio responded to a report involving two women arguing on the street. The suspect involved had been sitting in a vehicle belonging to the fiancé of the other woman. An argument began, leading the suspect to punch the other woman and kick the vehicle before leaving on foot. As officers arrived at the scene, they located the suspect, who continued walking away, ignoring orders to stop. 

The suspect ignored the officer's orders, stating he was not a “real cop.” As the officers attempted to arrest, the suspect began resisting officers. The suspect continued resisting as the officers eventually placed her in handcuffs. After her arrest, told officers she was 2 months pregnant and stated the officers were “fake officers”. Officers called for an ambulance to assess the suspect. As the suspect was assessed by medics, officers spoke to the woman involved in the incident. 

The woman told the officer she did not know the suspect and had confronted her after finding her inside her vehicle. The suspect threatened to fight the woman and her fiance before hitting her. After the suspect kicked the rear door, leaving a dent. The suspect was taken to hospital for medical clearance, where she continued arguing with officers. She was issued a citation for Obstructing Official Business but stated it was fake. The suspect was charged with Obstructing Official Business.
